title: The Milestone
subtitle: form: stepped, and the defaults named out loud
description: The first milestone north, and the climb to it drawn as the road
actually goes: `form: stepped`, the Z broken at the chord's
midpoint, because nobody has ever walked a switchback in a
straight line and the canvas is not going to pretend they did.
This line also names its defaults out loud -- `arrowHead: chevron`,
`arrowPlace: target` -- which is what the built-ins would have done
anyway, written down. A default nothing ever states is a default a
